status: Amendment 1 frozen before any response fit or score inspection. Initial raw-capture plan stopped at negative-input validation and is preserved in attempt-01.
scope: Coordinate-level diagnostic on a published aggregate-response export. Exact transformation lineage is unresolved. Not an equation-faithful reproduction, fitted recurrent-circuit reproduction, or new experiment.
transform: None. Use the four supplied signed coordinates unchanged. Do not take a second logarithm or clip them. Do not assign physical units to their fitted coefficients.
fitting: Ordinary weighted least squares, weights counts, separately for every supplied cell_type.
partition: Four folds, four repetitions with seed labels 11,12,13,14. SHA256(seed + colon + compact JSON of supplied four-coordinate vector rounded to 10 decimal places), first 8 digest bytes as big-endian integer modulo 4. Identical declared stimulus groups share a fold across cell types. This differs from the authors' RepeatedKFold partition. Near-neighbor stimuli need not be in one fold; this is interpolation, not distribution-shift testing.
metrics: count-weighted ordinary R-squared of out-of-fold predictions per repetition
mean and min/max over four repetitions, not confidence intervals
inclusion: All 6205 rows and all 14 cell labels if their inputs/response/weights are finite and counts positive. Supplied signed coordinates are allowed. Fail rather than silently drop invalid rows. Mutant labels fitted separately, not predicted by intervention.
inheritedPreprocessing: The public table is pooled and normalized before this split. Thus these are within-table diagnostics, not untouched experimental holdouts; animal/session/trial generalization cannot be established.
comparativeBoundary: Only linear diagnostic versus nested equal-coordinate-sum control. The control is not certified as physical luminance until encoding lineage is established. Original nonlinear, recurrent and other competent alternatives remain mandatory before SAN advantage claims.
